name: fade run --detach does not actually run anything
description: fade run --detach creates the run directory, writes metadata, prints a success message, and exits without launching any process (no nohup, no &). fade logs <run_id> returns empty. The feature misrepresents itself. Source: external engineering review 2026-07-05 (bin/fade-cli lines ~4323-4358). Either implement it properly or remove the flag.

userStories.title: Detach actually detaches
userStories.description: Launch the run as a real background process with output captured to the run directory.
acceptanceCriteria: fade run --detach launches the loop via nohup ... >> fade/runs/<run_id>/output.log 2>&1 & and records the PID in the run metadata
fade logs <run_id> tails the live output; fade status shows the run as active while the PID is alive
If implementing is judged out of scope, the flag is removed from CLI and README instead (a lying flag is worse than no flag)

technicalNotes.rationale: Small, well-located fix; review documented the exact broken region.
